plainText:
Volume 29: Assembly of the Ten is the 29th volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga. It is the final volume in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

==Blurb==
Gold and Crystal are back! Professor Oak sends the two friends to help rescue Red, Yellow, Blue and Green—who have all been turned to stone! But first, the pair must fight a fearsome opponent that Archie, the former leader of Team Aqua, wished into existence using the powers of the Wish Pokémon Jirachi! If only our heroes had the power of the ultimate moves… Then, will Emerald ever acknowledge his love of Pokémon…?

The Battle Frontier is flooded by the monster Kyogre.

The monster Kyogre is destroyed by the ten Pokédex holders.
The secret behind Archie's armor and sword is revealed, after which he disappears.
The Pokédex holders arrange a competition in the Battle Dome.
Professor Oak asks Todd Snap to take pictures on an island that only Pokémon are known to inhabit.
Jirachi returns to its millennium-long sleep.
Crystal and Professor Oak call Professor Rowan.

==Trivia==
The Emerald storyline ends on July 7th, which, coincidentally, is the same day that the US version of this volume was released.
